title: Alstonia Scholaris
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of malarial conditions and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic diarrhoea and dysentery. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of low-grade fevers. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach. Distended and tender. Chronic diarrhoea of thin, watery stools. Dysentery. Thin, watery, and foul-smelling. Bloody mucus. Compare: China; Arsenicum album; Podophyllum. Tincture to third potency.
